text: October 2026: we gave a corrugated metal roof in Coomera a soft wash, which is a low-pressure wash. Bird nest twigs and debris had clogged the valley, and leaves were packed along the roof edge. The roof finished clean and grey, with the ridge capping and screws clearly visible.
alt: Clean grey corrugated metal roof with ridge capping and screws, white buildings behind in Coomera
